entries.title: Automatic keeps what it read about this Mac when your project's host is slow
entries.body: When the place your project lives took more than 5 seconds to answer, Automatic threw away everything it had read about this Mac, and a ready task waited with every check marked unknown. Now only the project-access check reads unknown, so the waiting task names the one check that could not finish.
entries.noPicture: The waiting task's message keeps its look; it now lists one reason instead of five.
